requests.filter_pill.description: Requests area, filter bar above the rows. A control showing its current value, such as Genre: Comedy. {name} is the control's name (Genre, From, To, Mood); {value} is what it is set to, or the word for any.

requests.filter_genre.description: Requests area, filter bar. Name of the control that picks a movie genre. One short word.

requests.filter_from.description: Requests area, filter bar. Name of the control that picks the first release year of a range. One short word.

requests.filter_to.description: Requests area, filter bar. Name of the control that picks the last release year of a range. One short word.

requests.filter_mood.description: Requests area, filter bar. Name of the control that picks a subgenre or mood such as Heist or Time travel. One short word.

requests.filter_any.description: Requests area, filter bar. The value a control shows while it filters nothing.

requests.filter_any_genre.description: Requests area, filter bar choices. First choice of the genre list: no genre filter.

requests.filter_any_from.description: Requests area, filter bar choices. First choice of the first-year list: no earliest year.

requests.filter_any_to.description: Requests area, filter bar choices. First choice of the last-year list: no latest year.

requests.filter_any_mood.description: Requests area, filter bar choices. First choice of the mood list: no mood filter.

requests.filter_reset.description: Requests area, filter bar. Button that clears every filter at once. Shown only while a filter is set.

requests.filter_decade.description: Requests area, filter bar choices. A whole decade in the first-year list, such as 1920s. {year} is the decade's first year, such as 1920.

requests.filter_retry.description: Requests area, filter bar choices. Choice in the genre list when the genres could not be loaded: asks for them again.

requests.filter_none.description: Requests area. Read-out under the filter bar when the chosen genre, years and mood together match no movie.

requests.filter_none_reason.value: Try a wider range of years or a different mood.
requests.filter_none_reason.description: Requests area. Second line under the no-match read-out: what to change. One short sentence.

requests.popular.description: Requests area. Heading of the row of movies matching the filters, most popular first.

requests.top_rated.description: Requests area. Heading of the row of movies matching the filters, best rated first.

requests.newest.description: Requests area. Heading of the row of movies matching the filters, most recent release first.

requests.unfiltered_mine.description: Requests area. Heading of the viewer's own requests while a filter is set; the filter does not apply to this row.

requests.unfiltered_trending.description: Requests area. Heading of the trending row while a filter is set; the filter does not apply to this row.

requests.unfiltered_shows.description: Requests area. Heading of the popular shows row while a filter is set; the filter does not apply to this row.

requests.unfiltered_upcoming.description: Requests area. Heading of the coming-soon row while a filter is set; the filter does not apply to this row.
